description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MenuDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing functionalities related to menu items management such as enabling menu items, retrieving menu levels, and fetching modules by name.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Tests\Core\Dao\MenuDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the MenuDao data access object, ensuring correct behavior for module menu item enabling, retrieval, and module info lookups.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and creates a new instance of MenuDao.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Verifies that enabling menu items for a module correctly updates their status in the database.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItemsByTitle
methods.description: Tests enabling menu items by module name and specific titles, ensuring correct count of affected items.

methods.name: testGetMenuLevel
methods.description: Checks retrieval of menu item details including title, parent, level, order hint, and status.

methods.name: testGetModuleByName
methods.description: Verifies fetching module details by module name, including handling of invalid names.
